text:
Turns out I was the first to register for the
Champion Cup.\c
In other words, I’m already number one.
It’s pretty much in the bag that I’ll win this thing![VAR 0114(0005)]

[VAR 1003][VAR 0100(0000)], correct?\c
We’ve been watching over your performance in
the Gym Challenge.\c
This is just a formality, of course, but I’ll need
to check your Gym Badges, if you don’t mind.
I’m all sorted and ready to battle you on the\nbiggest stage of them all![VAR 0114(0005)]

But it looks like Bede couldn’t make it.
Hard luck...\c
Somehow I didn’t think he’d just take being
disqualified lying down, you know what I mean?[VAR 0114(0005)]
I guess it is what it is...\c\nCome on, [VAR 0100(0000)].\nWe should head to the locker room![VAR 0114(0005)]

This is it. I really made it.\c
I made it through the Gym Challenge. There
might be four remainin’ in the Semifinals...\c
But I’m the one who’s gonna win through
and battle the Champion.[VAR 0114(000D)]
